title: Visa Product Design
description: This project supported Visa's 2022 digital rebrand rollout at global scale. I was a Lead Designer on the team that rebuilt the global Figma design system and replaced Sketch workflows, helping teams ship consistent, accessible experiences faster. In close collaboration with strategists, researchers, and copywriters, we delivered 50+ landing pages and campaigns while exploring future-facing concepts for Visa's digital presence.

article.headline: One design system for six continents
blocks: When Visa unveiled its 2021 brand refresh, the question was never whether the new identity looked good on a slide deck. The question was whether it could survive contact with 200+ product teams shipping across six continents. I joined as Lead Designer to make sure it did.
Killing Sketch, One Token at a Time

The legacy system was a patchwork of Sketch files maintained by regional teams who rarely talked to each other. Tokyo's button had 16px padding. London's had 12px. New York had both. We migrated everything to Figma, but the migration was never the hard part. The hard part was convincing people that a single source of truth was worth the pain of changing how they worked.

We built every component with embedded usage guidelines directly in the Figma file. Hover over a button variant and you'd see when to use it, when not to, and which accessibility requirements it satisfied. This reduced design review cycles by roughly 40% in the first quarter after rollout.

During the FIFA World Cup partnership, we shipped 54 landing pages in eleven languages across eight weeks. Each page shared a layout system but needed to feel locally relevant. The design system made this possible.

I designed the template architecture — a flexible grid of interchangeable content blocks that marketing teams could assemble without touching Figma. They'd fill a spreadsheet, and the dev team would generate the page.

Design systems are political projects disguised as technical ones. The hardest conversations weren't about border-radius values. They were about whose opinion gets encoded into the default, and who has to override it.

title: Digitas AI
description: Digitas AI is an internal platform project for orchestrating AI agents across teams. I led experience design from workflow definition to interface design, then partnered closely with engineers through implementation.

title: Conversational AI
description: Text became the main way we talk to AI. Because of that, conversational interfaces became one of the most essential user interface element. I've been working on conversational interfaces for a few years now.

title: Global Brands
description: Worked with many global brands like Visa, Sephora, Delta, Amway, Mondelez, L'Oreal, RaceTrac. Everything from products and interfaces to global campaigns and immersive experiences.

title: Prototyping
description: Quick iteration with AI in Figma Make or Claude Code with Figma MCP, and then detailed prototypes with complex animations in Figma. This was my main approach for prototyping for the last year. The prototyping keep evolving, and I'm always staying ahead of all the latest practices, because it is an essential part of any workflow.

title: Amway Website
description: Redesigned Amway's digital experience across site architecture, component libraries, and visual design. I directed the work to build a scalable system that supports consistency across global products.

title: Generative Media
description: I use a lot of generative tools: Google Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Visual Electric, Qwen for images; Kling, Wan, Sora for video. My workflows range from quick apps like Higgsfield to building custom pipelines in ComfyUI and Weavy.

title: Motion Design
description: Figma for quick motion examples, After Effects and Cavalry for complex motion assets. I love working with motion and always keep my skills up to date.

title: Design Systems
description: Built design systems for Visa, RaceTrac, Amway, and more. Components, tokens, variables, documentation. I love organizing, structuring, and making sure every small piece fits into the bigger picture.

title: AI Workflows
description: Figuring out how design and AI actually work together. Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, MCP tools—using AI across research, ideation, prototyping, designing and code.

title: Mindcomplete
description: AI-powered writing assistant that completes your thoughts in real-time. Mindcomplete helps you write faster and more fluidly by predicting and suggesting how to continue your paragraphs. Simply pause while typing, and AI will suggest a natural continuation matching your tone and style.

title: UI UX
description: Led product design for Visa's global digital presence, directed redesigns for Amway, RaceTrac, Delta. Websites, apps, dashboards, design systems. Always thinking about how it looks and how it actually works.

title: Branding
description: Brand identity work across 15 years, from startups to federal brands. Logo systems, visual identities, brand guidelines. Foundation that shaped how I think about consistency and systems.

title: Building Tools
description: I keep building small tools that solve problems I actually have. iOS apps, Figma plugins, web tools, Apple shortcuts. Most started as personal experiments, some turned into real products.

title: Journely
description: Journely is an iPad app exploring handwriting-first conversational journaling. I created it as an experiment in more natural AI interaction, blending handwritten input with conversational intelligence.

title: Public Talks
description: I've given several public talks about AI and design. Sharing experiments, tools, and interesting ways designers can use AI in their work.

title: RaceTrac App
description: A full redesign of the RaceTrac app, including a complete interface overhaul, a rebuilt rewards experience, and a new design system. I was the Lead Designer on both the pitch design that won the project and the product redesign execution.

title: 36 Days of Type
description: Creative coding exploration. I animated every letter using OpenFrameworks and AI, trying to see how code and design could mix.

title: Plantlife
description: PlantLife is a social platform project for plant lovers to connect, shop, and share expertise. I helped shape the product from early concept, leading UI design, design system foundations, and brand communications.

title: Logo Design
description: I've designed over 100 logos throughout my career. Seeing them printed on shipping containers, store signs, and merchandise all over the world never gets old.

title: Packaging Design
description: Packaging design taught me to think about the physical world—materials, production, and how things actually look on a shelf. My work was featured in Dieline and Packaging of the World.

title: Visa Analytics Platform
description: A redesign of Visa Analytics Platform, a global self-service product that helps financial institutions turn payments data into decisions.

title: Peace Sans Free Font
description: Peace Sans is a personal type design project that I created and released for free. It became one of the most downloaded free fonts on Behance, reaching 500K+ downloads.
